title: File:201406 Niaolongkou of Ninghai National Fitness Trail.jpg
claims: A wide view from the Ninghai National Fitness Trail: a rough grass-and-soil path with a low wooden fence in the foreground, scrub and small cultivated plots on the left, and wooded low mountain ridges fading into a hazy valley beyond. It is a location photograph, not a 2026 race-day photograph, and it does not show a start arch, finish gantry, bib, timing mat, aid table, course marking or race crowd.

Commons titles the file 201406 Niaolongkou of Ninghai National Fitness Trail.jpg. The route page uses it as trail-environment context for a race that starts and finishes at Ximen Gate in Ninghai county; it does not show the gate, the 2026 start arch, a bib, an aid station, course marking or a race-day crowd.

The Commons author field reads MNXANL; the file is marked CC-BY-SA-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); the relevant date is 2014-06-14 11:33:52; the file page gives no camera coordinates; the original is 1,786 × 578 px; 231,163 bytes.

The route page uses a 960 × 311 px; 88,058 bytes copy without cropping or colour change and credits MNXANL, CC-BY-SA-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/), Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
